links.note: Naming the three tiers and the key functions of each - this concept sets out the system working at three levels from the bottom up, village, block and district, and describes the Gram Panchayat at the base. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.
Writing a letter to the Sarpanch about plastic bags lying on the roadside is verbatim one of this concept's closing questions.
The village school next to a highway where students cannot cross safely, and which Panchayati Raj institutions can help, is verbatim the last of this concept's closing questions.

What the reservation of seats for disadvantaged sections aims at - this concept's THINK ABOUT IT asks precisely why it is important for the government to pay more attention to the needs and problems of the disadvantaged sections of society, so the rule is presented as something to be justified.
Vandana Bahadur Maida as a member of the Bhil community from Khankhandvi in Madhya Pradesh - this concept's profile of her. Already linked and correct.
The Panchayat Samiti at the block level as the link between the Gram Panchayat and the Zila Parishad at the district level - this concept's sentence, which is what makes it the intermediate tier.

What the Arthashastra covers - how a state should be structured and run, how the economy can be made prosperous, the duties of the ruler and how to conduct war - is listed in this concept, and modern elections are not among them.
Dnyaneshwar Kamble, a transgender person who was Sarpanch of Tarangfal in Solapur district in 2017 - this concept's profile.
Vandana Maida addressing critical issues like education and sanitation after convincing women to attend the Sabha meetings - this concept's account. Already linked and correct.
Popatrao Baguji Pawar applying Anna Hazare's model of rainwater harvesting and watershed conservation at Hiware Bazar - this concept's story. Already linked and correct.
Almost two-thirds of India's 1.4 billion people living in rural areas - this concept's figure, and the reason this chapter comes before the urban one. Already linked and correct.

The challenge of governing a country of enormous size and diversity with about 600,000 villages, 8,000 towns and over 4,000 cities - this concept's opening, closing on the question of how we govern ourselves in this complex society. Already linked and correct.
A Panchayat as the system of local government referring to a village council - this concept's opening definition.

The Gram Sabha as the group of adults from a village or neighbouring villages who are enrolled as voters - this concept's definition, and the one body in the chapter that is direct rather than representative. Already linked and correct.
The provision for reserving one-third of the seats for women - this concept states it at all three levels, alongside the special rules for disadvantaged sections.
The Arthashastra written by Kautilya, later also known as Chanakya - this concept names him.
A sangrahana, or sub-district headquarters, for every 10 villages - this concept's first figure from Kautilya's scheme.

Kautilya's four categories from the village to the provincial capital showing an early tiered structure - this concept asks what names we would give them today and remarks that a similar structure was thought of so long ago.

The assertion is this concept's closing sentence - the objectives are the same, to enable villagers to take an active part in the management and development of their villages and the local area - and the reason restates the self-governance that follows from it.

The false pair credits Popatrao Pawar with industrial pollution control; this concept records his actual work, rainwater harvesting, watershed conservation and the planting of lakhs of trees at Hiware Bazar, for which he received the Padma Shri.

Popatrao Pawar's work at Hiware Bazar was rainwater harvesting and watershed management, not industrial pollution control - this concept's story. Already linked and correct. Note: this item duplicates the preceding one, with the model answer pasted into its stem.

Lakshmanpur villagers meeting over their water supply - this concept invents that village and lists water for the fields among its needs, then asks where villagers will take such decisions. Already linked and correct.
Kamble's motto lok seva, gram seva, service to the village is service to the public - this concept quotes it.

The structure and functions of Panchayati Raj institutions differing a little across states because the states have authority over those institutions - this concept states both halves of the assertion and reason.
The objective of Anna Hazare's model as applied at Hiware Bazar - rainwater harvesting, watershed conservation and groundwater recharge, that is, conserving water. Already linked and correct.
A karvatika, district headquarters, for every 100 villages - this concept's second figure from Kautilya.
The Children's Parliament engaging children aged 8 to 14 in governance, learning democracy and social responsibility through night schools and parliament-like elections. Already linked and correct.

Bal Panchayats and Children's Parliaments engaging children in democratic processes and giving them a platform to voice their concerns - this concept's Rajasthan example. Already linked and correct. Note: this item duplicates the preceding one, with the model answer pasted into its stem.
Dronamukha as the unit for every 400 villages is the one correct pair, and all four terms - sangrahana, karvatika, dronamukha, sthaniya - with their village counts come from this concept.
